title: Mean Corpuscular Volume
subtitle: What mean corpuscular volume measures, how to interpret it, limitations, and when it is clinically useful.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from standard hematology literature and expert guidelines supports MCV measurement as a key diagnostic parameter in anemia evaluation. Emerging evidence continues to explore its role combined with newer biomarkers for refined diagnosis.
